extension.news: 2026-08-31 * First run after a build install starts the build's binary installer so InstallAddon no longer waits for a second boot * Speedtest keeps local results if there is no speedtest.net image, tries HTTPS for upload, and shows a toast if the test fails * Speedtest ping uses a 10 second timeout and averages the probes that actually ran * Restore from backup skips natives that do not belong on this OS and prepares binary add-ons the same way as a build install * Video Cache Settings can auto-detect size from free RAM * Speedtest now uses the same JSON endpoint as the speedtest.net website
